channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: ‘Rent’ Star Anthony Rapp Brings Holiday Cabaret To The Lookingglass Theatre
item.description: The stage and screen star, who moved back to Chicago this year, acknowledges the emotional complexity of the season in "Home for the Holidays," which runs Wednesday through Saturday.

item.title: Signal Chat Group Comes Together To Make Holiday Cards For Kids Affected By ICE Raids
item.description: Irving Park resident Doreen Sayegh runs a Signal chat that has been organizing card-making meetups with the community.

item.title: Garbage Fee Hike Scrapped As Alternative Budget Proposal Faces Initial Vote Tuesday
item.description: Alderpeople backing the proposal that avoids a head tax will hold a committee vote Tuesday, but they have yet to reveal the full details of their plan. Mayor Brandon Johnson blasted the group and their process Monday.

item.title: New Illinois Laws In 2026: What You Need To Know
item.description: State laws will affect ICE protocols, workplace breaks and school bullying protections.

item.title: Neighbors Rally Around Lakeview Bar After Burglars Steal Donated Presents For Families In Need
item.description: Olive Black was burglarized last week, prompting an outpouring of support for a business known for helping neighbors.

item.title: Border Patrol Boss Greg Bovino Back In Chicago As Agents Target Southwest Side
item.description: Bovino returned with around 200 agents and descended on the Southwest Side Tuesday, where organizers said around 15 people were arrested. "It's going to be a merry Christmas in Chicago," Bovino told Block Club reporters.

item.title: Will Chicago Have A White Christmas? Odds Don’t Look Good With Warmup On The Way
item.description: Chicago can expect high temps in the 30s and 40s this week that will likely melt any remaining snow.

item.title: Brighton Park Road Upgrades Draw Outrage From Community, Citing Traffic Spikes And Business Woes
item.description: The project is bringing bike lanes and other pedestrian and cyclist safety upgrades to dangerous stretches of South Archer and Kedzie Avenues in Brighton Park.

item.title: Group Planning 2,000 Affordable Homes For South, West Sides Wins $10 Million Chicago Prize
item.description: Reclaiming Chicago plans to use its prize winnings to fund a project to build homes on a 17-acre site in Chicago Lawn.

item.title: City Council’s Finance Committee Advances Alternative Budget Without Head Tax, Defying Johnson
item.description: The proposal would regulate video gambling machines, increase the shopping bag fee, add a tax on retail liquor sales and place ads on bridge houses and light poles. Alderpeople also greenlit a small property tax hike to increase library funding.
